text:
Anne (CS): Hey team — final sync for BlueHarbor dedicated bring-up. Need to lock quotas, load-test window, and who owns on-call during warmup.
Mike S (SRE): I can take SRE lead for the warmup and the initial 48h smoke. What's their expected RPS and burst profile?
Julian (Acct): BlueHarbor committed to 120k tokens/min baseline, with 3x burst for campaign windows. Renewal conversation in 6 weeks — want to avoid any early hiccups.
Sara (Eng-Infra): Ok noted. For autoscale policy I'm proposing: min_replicas:4, target_concurrency:250, max_replicas:20. Will paste the exact config after.
Anne (CS): We should also schedule a customer enablement session to walk BlueHarbor through the Console dashboards and cost breakdowns. Proposed slot: next Wed 10am PT. @Julian can you confirm?
Julian (Acct): Next Wed 10am PT works for them. I'll send calendar invite and onboarding checklist.
Mike S (SRE): Quick runbook additions: - Healthcheck thresholds (95% tokens served under 600ms) - Auto-fallback to smaller model variant if latency > 1200ms for >2min - Alert to #eng-oncall on scale events >10 replicas within 5m
Sara (Eng-Infra): Autoscaler config snippet (for infra team):
```yaml
policy_name: blueharbor-dedicated-autoscale
min_replicas: 4
max_replicas: 20
target_rps_per_replica: 250
scale_up_window: 30s
scale_down_window: 5m
cooldown: 2m
fallback_model: rdx-small-v1
```
Mike S (SRE): For load tests let's do two phases: 1) baseline ramp (1h) to 1x expected (120k tokens/min) 2) stress bursts (3x for 15m every hour over 4h). We should run these during low-impact window: Friday 02:00-07:00 PT.
Anne (CS): BlueHarbor requested limited telemetry retention in logs (GDPR region). Ensure any test data is scrubbed and the private CP is used.
Sara (Eng-Infra): Acknowledge. We'll use private control plane, scrub prompts, and disable trace sampling above 10% during tests.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: blueharbor-dedicated-v1 -> 2026-03-27T02:00:00Z (canary 10% -> 100% over 30m).
Mike S (SRE): I'll run a dry-run of the loadscript locally: `./tools/loadgen --scenario blueharbor --rps 2000 --burst 3x`. I'll post results to this thread.
Anne (CS): Owner matrix: Customer comms -> Julian; Enablement demo -> Anne; SRE warmup & monitoring -> Mike; Autoscaler & infra -> Sara.
Julian (Acct): I'll include renewal risk notes in the QBR doc and flag that successful warmup reduces churn risk.
Mike S (SRE): One more: add a synthetic check that validates model fallback correctness (response schema + tokens <= expected). I can add that to the smoke suite.
Anne (CS): Great — can everyone ack on the plan? If no blockers I'll finalize the runbook and post in #eng-oncall and the shared BlueHarbor workspace. :thumbsup:
Sara (Eng-Infra): Ack.
Mike S (SRE): Ack.
Julian (Acct): Ack.
Anne (CS): Thanks — I'll schedule the enablement and share the finalized checklist by EOD tomorrow.
__notes: Generated synthetic Slack thread for dedicated capacity bring-up coordination (quota, autoscale, load tests).
